actions.name: follow line: curve left on black, right otherwise

control_flow: followInTheDark: if RLIGHT < 60, then if LLIGHT < 45 curve 15/35, else if line tracker > 95 curve 35/15, else avoidWalls; otherwise avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT < 70, then if obstacle LEFT turn right 20, else if obstacle RIGHT turn left 20, else driveInTheDark; otherwise driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 drive forward 30, else stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if obstacle FRONT stop, else followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve 10/40, else curve 40/10.

likely_intent.description: In the dark, follow a black line when one is under the robot, and drive straight where there is none; in the light, follow the line as before.

branches.outcome: the right light is below 60 %: the dark branch runs
the right light is 60 % or more: avoidWalls runs

decision_points.condition: LLIGHT < 45, then the line tracker is above 95 %

branches.outcome: the left light is below 45 %: it curves left 15/35
left light is at least 45 % and the line tracker is above 95 %: it curves right 35/15
the left light is below 70 %: it checks the side obstacle sensors
the left light is 70 % or more: driveInTheDark runs
an obstacle is on the left: it turns right 20°
no left obstacle, an obstacle is on the right: it turns left 20°
no obstacle on either side: driveInTheDark runs
the left light is below 70 %: it drives forward at 30 %
the left light is 70 % or more: stopAtWall runs
an obstacle is ahead: it stops
the line tracker sees black: it curves left 10/40
the line tracker does not see black: it curves right 40/10
